narrative: On the tables. The tables on the cleared board, one list in his hand, no line struck through. Brooke on the left. The tied comedy is up on the shelf, out of this view. On the tables. The same five items. No stroke. The pen is set down beside the tables, not on them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the list and did not strike a line.

entities.name: tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Nothing struck
